data.name: Vault.Subtitle
data.value: Characters you keep outside any campaign. To play one, open a campaign's Cast and choose Bring a character.

data.name: Vault.SystemHint
data.value: A character can join only campaigns of this system. It can't be changed later.

data.name: Vault.EmptyBody
data.value: Make a character here to keep it for any campaign you join.

data.name: Vault.DeleteBody
data.value: It is deleted from your characters for good. Copies already in campaigns stay there.

data.name: Vault.StartConcept
data.value: A concept: the AI drafts the sheet and a history

data.value: e.g. A former pirate turned temple guard, level 3.

data.name: Vault.ConceptHint
data.value: The AI picks only classes, species, gear and the rest from the server's Library for this system. Check the sheet afterwards.

data.name: Vault.NoAi
data.value: No AI model is set up for you. Add one under AI settings.

data.name: Vault.Data.Intro
data.value: Download everything of yours as one zip file: the characters here, your private journals, and every campaign you run, with its pictures. Keys and passwords are never in it.

data.name: Vault.Data.ImportHint
data.value: A downloaded zip, or the vault.json inside it. Its characters are added as new ones; any you have stay.
